title: Eludite command spec
description: The public description of a command on the Eludite command bus (PLAN.md 5.1), shared by the UI, the audit log and the MCP server. A command whose `agent_visible` is true is advertised to hosted agents as an MCP tool (protocol/schemas/mcp-tool.json); the others stay UI-only (window layout and view filters). The permission class decides what the MCP boundary does with an agent's call (PLAN.md 5.3): `read` runs without a prompt; `edit_buffer` edits are held as pending changes for review; `execute` and `dangerous` prompt in the Agents window unless the solution's policy file (protocol/schemas/agents-policy.json) decides.

id.description: Dotted lowercase command id, e.g. eludite.file.open.

title.description: As the menus and the command palette show it (`File: Open`).

input_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of the input (a file in protocol/schemas/).

agent_visible.description: Advertised to agents as an MCP tool.
